Nepal Floods Prompt Environmental Warnings and Himachal Pradesh Alert

Environmentalists have issued warnings regarding the Nepal floods, emphasizing the growing threats to the Himalayas and the necessity of sustainable development. Following the devastation in Nepal, Himachal Pradesh has been placed on alert, with authorities monitoring four glacial lakes. The alert system aims to provide advance warning of potential dangers.
